name: Laments of a Platinum Rose
source:
You are L1L1TH, the first of your kind. A truly bio-mechanical automaton. Developed with a programmed loyalty to your Queen. Political unrest is brewing somewhere deep within the capital city of Luminary, you are sent by yourself to discover all the truths that lie hidden away, and protect your Queen.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4263100/]Steam[/url]]
